I for one am convinced that Min retained the role that Mat advised her to take during the Last Battle; chief advisor to the Seanchan Empress - Tuon. It would not only make sense as Tuon - or Fortuona - will likely want to keep her "true reader of the omens", ''but'' it will simplify life greatly for all the Westland rulers (and thereby the Westlands) that two of the Dragon's brides hold offices of such vast political power, Elayne as Queen of Andor and Cairhien and Min as the Truthspeaker to the Seanchan Empress. She could slowly wiggle herself into Fortuona's trust to start reading the omens in a favourable way for the path that the Westlands follow; such as, in the end, Min would have to "read the omens" that it is time to release all ''damane'', as Fortuona will herself one day otherwise be collared. Not even Fortuona, I think, would be that subservient to her own laws. Also, such a decision would make sense because the Seanchan continent is in chaos and civil war, and plenty of lords have ''sul'dam'' and ''damane'' that they can use freely in battle. The ''damane'' have to go. And so, I can lean back content and happy in the assurance that the vile monstrosity that is the Seanchan Empire must either undergo a tremendous Reformation or crumble and disappear.

As for other characters... Hmm... If I'm allowed to guess, I think Moiraine and Thom withdrew to some garden deep into the countryside, just the two of them, having experienced enough adventure, fame and fortune for ten lifetimes. *giggle*
